description: Procurement of medicines required to maintain health services
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-10-05 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited following the international competitive bidding procedure for the procurement of the following essential medicines required to maintain health services of the general public. Based on the recommendations made by the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee, upon the evaluation of the said bids, the proposals made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the relevant contracts, were approved by the Cabinet: Serial NoTypes of MedicineQuantityNumber of bids receivedRecommended bidderValue01Rabies Vaccine (Human Use)3,400,000 doses (0.5 ml/1 ml) of inactivated vaccine04Gulf Pharma (Pvt) Limited, Sri Lanka (Manufacturer: Chiron Behring Vaccine (Pvt) Ltd, India)Rs.420.41 million02Human Albumin solution187,500 bottles (50 ml, 20%) - BP/USP/Ph.Eur.05Takeda Pharmaceuticals International AG, Switzerland (Part of Takeda Pharmaceutical Company Limited) (Manufacturer: Takeda Manufacturing Austria AG; Local Agent: A.J. Medichem International (Pvt) Ltd, Colombo)US$ 3.71 million
